evidence_description: Establishes clinical exception criteria directing joint arthroplasty and outpatient spine surgery to ambulatory surgery centers (ASC) unless hospital admission criteria are met.
Intake checklist for hip, knee, and shoulder surgery collecting weight-bearing radiographs, conservative therapy duration, injections, and functional limitation.
Intake checklist for cervical and lumbar spine surgery collecting MRI/CT evidence, concordant neurologic deficit exam findings, and conservative therapy history.
Standardized clinical form capturing >= 6 weeks of active physical therapy, medication trials, epidural steroid injections, and provider attestation for spine surgery.
Standardized clinical form capturing >= 12 weeks of non-operative therapy, home exercise, assistive devices, NSAID trials, and joint injections for arthroplasty.
Clinical tip sheet detailing commercial health plan medical necessity requirements for total hip and total knee arthroplasty, including Kellgren-Lawrence Grade III/IV.
Clinical tip sheet aligning Medicare Advantage arthroplasty criteria with CMS Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) and national clinical benchmarks.
Tip sheet establishing indications for therapeutic knee arthroscopy (meniscectomy, loose body removal) and non-coverage of arthroscopy for uncomplicated osteoarthritis.
Tip sheet outlining anatomic vs reverse total shoulder arthroplasty indications, rotator cuff tear arthropathy criteria, and imaging benchmarks.
Tip sheet summarizing rotator cuff repair, labral repair, and subacromial decompression indications and prior conservative treatment standards.
